properties.name: weakcrypto:config
properties.value: skill pq-crypto, 2 scouts, max iterations 400, build bbcd802706e4

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-presence record for the client's dev toolchain: node-forge 1.3.1 (RSA keygen/encrypt/sign, X.509, TLS) ships with the client build via selfsigned ← webpack-dev-server. No direct application call site in client/src; the RSA capability is what the inventory records. Changeable here by swapping the dev-server HTTPS plugin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Template asset, changeable here by bumping the vendored template: secp256k1 ECDSA capability is baked into every program users scaffold from this template. Quantum-unsafe signature (deadline risk, ML-DSA-65 migration) — but note Solana's own syscall/SDK constraints, so replacement is realistically an upstream-Solana decision, observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the signature scheme of the whole Solana stack: wallet message signing client-side (@noble/curves, tweetnacl via @solana/web3.js) and Solana program verification server-side (ed25519-dalek). Quantum-unsafe signature — deadline risk, migrate to ML-DSA-65. Availability records like this are how a reader learns the shipped posture on both sides.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Curve25519 arithmetic available to the Solana programs build via the solana-program crate tree; no direct call in the default program source (server/programs/default/src/lib.rs is a minimal Anchor program). Availability record for the programs side of the playground.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES (crypto-js) available to the client bundle transitively via merkletreejs (Merkle proofs for candy-machine/Sugar-style drops). Record of shipped capability; mode/key size would be decided by merkletreejs's usage (crypto-js is mainly used there for hashing, AES is the headline cipher of the package).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the workhorse hash on both sides of this project. Presence record spanning two ecosystems; no single provider to link.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 on both sides: browser bundle via @noble/hashes, server via the blake3 crate — where it has a live call site at server/src/routes/unstable/bundle.rs (Hasher chain as the bundle cache key, reported separately).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC in the server comes from the mongodb crate: SCRAM-SHA-1/SCRAM-SHA-256 password proofs on the server↔MongoDB connection (server/src/db.rs). MAC primitive, PQ-safe as a construction (HMAC-SHA-256). Same dependency as LIB-b7b84e73 records at the library level.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party direct dependency: blake3 hashes manifest+lock+command bytes as the bundle cache key in server/src/routes/unstable/bundle.rs (live Hasher chain reported as a finding). PQ-safe hash; recorded so the CBOM shows the server's actual hashing primitive.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The server's TLS stack: mongodb 2.8 → rustls 0.21.10 (with ring 0.17.7 and rustls-pemfile) for the database connection. rustls 0.21 negotiates TLS 1.2/1.3 with classical groups only (X25519/P-256/P-384); PQ hybrid X25519MLKEM768 needs rustls ≥0.23 + aws-lc-rs — sessions are harvestable classical ECDHE. Upgradeable here by bumping the mongodb/rustls dependency line.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NaCl primitives in the production client bundle: @solana/web3.js Keypair signing/verifying and NaCl box via the SDK; near-hd-key (BIP39→Ed25519 HD derivation) is transitive via arbundles. Ed25519/X25519/XSalsa20-Poly1305 — all quantum-unsafe. Changeable here only by upstream SDK choices; the client app itself has no direct tweetnacl import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 is compiled into the server build solely for legacy SCRAM-SHA-1 support in the mongodb driver — weak hash (CWE-328 class) present in the shipped binary even though SCRAM-SHA-256 is the driver default. Removing it means configuring MongoDB to refuse SCRAM-SHA-1.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Library facet of the secp256k1 ECDSA capability recorded as ALG-6e1f67ab at the algorithm level — one vendored-template dependency, two names.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring is the crypto provider backing rustls 0.21 for the MongoDB TLS session: AES-GCM, X25519 key agreement, ECDSA P-256 certificate verification, SHA-2, Ed25519. Its version decides PQ capability as much as rustls's — ring has no PQ groups in any release to date. No direct application call sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt (memory-hard KDF) available to the client bundle via the Solana/Metaplex JS stack — transitive presence record.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 availability on the programs side: solana-program's crate tree brings ed25519-dalek so scaffolded programs can verify Ed25519 signatures. Quantum-unsafe signature scheme — part of the Solana ecosystem's deadline-risk migration story (ML-DSA-65).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1/SHA-2 browser hashing in the client bundle via the Solana JS stack; sha.js is what several SDKs fall back to for hashing at runtime.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The blake3 crate is both declared and actively used (server/src/routes/unstable/bundle.rs cache-key hashing — reported as a finding). The 1.5.0 version in the object name looks stale against the current lock (1.8.7) but the dependency itself is real.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hash surface of the client bundle: @noble/hashes is the modern, audited hash library of the Solana JS stack (and the provider the client app itself would use).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-only PKI generator: minted certs serve webpack-dev-server's local HTTPS endpoint during development. Not in the production bundle; the shipped algorithm capability is RSA (via node-forge) — see ALG-589856a1.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Library facet of the HMAC capability recorded as ALG-0db1f0bc — one mongodb-crate dependency, two names.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Library facet of the TLS 1.3 capability recorded as ALG-f42564d9 — the rustls dependency that decides whether PQ hybrid groups are even available (0.21: no; ≥0.23 + aws-lc-rs: yes).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Part of the secp256k1/elliptic JS cluster (elliptic@6.5.4 + hash.js + sha.js) that the Solana/Metaplex SDKs drag into the browser bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-2 in the server build: SCRAM-SHA-256 proofs for MongoDB plus the solana/anchor-syn dependency tree. PQ-safe hash family.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Curve25519 library facet of the programs build (recorded as ALG-82f1eeb2 at the algorithm level) — solana-program's Ed25519/X25519 arithmetic backend.
